title: Bimaterial effect and favorable energy ratio enabled supershear rupture in the 2025 Mandalay earthquake | Science
content: Joint seismic and geodetic analyses revealed that the 2025 moment magnitude (Mw) 7.8 Mandalay, Myanmar, earthquake ruptured ~510 km of the Sagaing fault, with a sustained supershear rupture extending ~450 km on the southern branch. Far-field Mach waves ...
